name: Dutch Wife ~Omae no Tsuma wa Ore no Mono~
original_name: 奪痴人妻～おまえの妻はオレの肉人形～
source:
One day, Masaki's mother tells him that he actually has a twin brother, Masaya. Masaya was adopted by a rich family when they were kids and he is now married to a beautiful woman, according to her. He gets mad to hear it and makes up his mind to destroy their happy life. At first, he plans to abduct and confine Masaya and rape his wife...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090302110524/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1009733]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
一天，正树的母亲告诉他，其实他还有一个双胞胎兄弟正也。兄弟二人年幼时，正也被富裕家庭收养，如今已经迎娶了一名美丽妻子。正树听后怒不可遏，决心摧毁他们的幸福生活。他首先计划绑架并囚禁正也，再强奸他的妻子…
